sentences.en: Thanks to President Obama's Affordable Care Act, integrated care has become a major priority within the health care industry.
sentences.zh: 得益于奥巴马总统的《平价医疗法案》，整合医疗已成为医疗保健行业的一项重要优先事项。

sentences.en: But what is integrated care?
sentences.zh: 但什么是整合医疗呢？

sentences.en: How does it affect children, families, and older adults?
sentences.zh: 它对儿童、家庭和老年人有什么影响？

sentences.en: And what are patient-centered medical homes?
sentences.zh: 什么是“以患者为中心的医疗之家”？

sentences.en: In this episode, we break down the ins and outs of integrated care with a psychologist who is a leading researcher on integrated care.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们将与一位在整合医疗领域处于领先地位的研究心理学家一起，深入剖析整合医疗的方方面面。

sentences.en: I'm Audrey Hamilton, and this is Speaking of Psychology.
sentences.zh: 我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿，这里是《心理学谈话》。

sentences.en: Joan Asarno is Director of the Youth Stress and Mood Program and a Professor of Psychiatry and Biobehavioral Sciences at UCLA.
sentences.zh: 琼·阿萨诺是加州大学洛杉矶分校青少年压力与情绪项目主任，也是精神病学和生物行为科学教授。

sentences.en: Her research focuses on strategies for improving health and mental health in youth, with an emphasis on suicide prevention and depression.
sentences.zh: 她的研究重点是改善青少年健康和心理健康的策略，特别强调自杀预防和抑郁症治疗。

sentences.en: She was also on the
sentences.zh: 她还曾任职于

sentences.en: American Psychological Association's Task Force on Patient-Centered Medical Homes.
sentences.zh: 美国心理学会“以患者为中心的医疗之家”特别工作组。

sentences.en: Welcome,
sentences.zh: 欢迎您，

sentences.en: Dr. Asarno.
sentences.zh: 阿萨诺博士。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I'm delighted to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: Your primary area of research focuses on mental health care and prevention for children and teenagers.
sentences.zh: 您的主要研究领域是儿童和青少年的心理健康护理与预防。

sentences.en: You've also been publishing research on the effect collaborative care settings have on these children.
sentences.zh: 您还发表过关于协作护理环境对这些儿童影响的研究。

sentences.en: Can you talk about that?
sentences.zh: 能谈谈这方面的情况吗？

sentences.en: I would be happy to.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意。

sentences.en: You know, in the United States, we can obtain outstanding medical care, and we can obtain outstanding care for behavioral health problems, a broad term that we use to refer
sentences.zh: 你知道，在美国，我们可以获得出色的医疗护理，也可以为行为健康问题获得出色的护理——这是一个广义术语，我们用它来指代

sentences.en: to mental health and substance abuse problems and health risk behaviors.
sentences.zh: 心理健康、药物滥用问题以及健康风险行为。

sentences.en: We can get the best mental health and substance abuse care in the world, in the United States, but where we have the problems is in getting that care to people.
sentences.zh: 在美国，我们可以获得世界上最好的心理健康和药物滥用护理，但问题在于如何让人们真正获得这些护理。

sentences.en: From the perspective of kids in mental health, we have some really major probleMs. First of all, there are very high rates of mental health problems among our kids.
sentences.zh: 从儿童心理健康的角度来看，我们确实存在一些重大问题。首先，我们孩子中的心理健康问题发生率非常高。

sentences.en: Estimates for adolescents indicate that 40% of our adolescents suffer from mental health or substance abuse disorders within any year, and in younger kids, it's one out of
sentences.zh: 据估计，在青少年中，40%的人在一年内会患有心理健康或药物滥用障碍；而在年幼儿童中，估计有八分之一

sentences.en: eight kids who are estimated to suffer from mental health disorders during a year.
sentences.zh: 的孩子在一年内会患有心理健康障碍。

sentences.en: This translates to about 16 million children in the United States who suffer from mental health or substance abuse probleMs.
sentences.zh: 这意味着在美国，约有1600万儿童患有心理健康或药物滥用问题。

sentences.en: The second really alarming fact is that over half of those kids with a documented need for mental health
sentences.zh: 第二个令人震惊的事实是，在那些有明确心理健康需求的孩子中，超过一半

sentences.en: care receive no services for those probleMs. And this unmet need is associated with lack of insurance and minority status.
sentences.zh: 的人没有得到任何相关服务。这种未满足的需求与缺乏保险和少数族裔身份有关。

sentences.en: And when treated, members of racial and ethnic minority groups and poor children also tend to receive poorer quality of care compared to non-minorities.
sentences.zh: 而且在接受治疗时，与非少数族裔相比，种族和少数族裔群体成员以及贫困儿童往往获得的护理质量也较差。

sentences.en: And this contributes to disparities in care and health outcomes.
sentences.zh: 这导致了护理和健康结果方面的差异。

sentences.en: We had a study that came out in JAMA Pediatrics in August 2015 that was designed to ask the question,
sentences.zh: 我们在2015年8月的《美国医学会杂志·儿科学》上发表了一项研究，旨在探讨一个问题：

sentences.en: if you put care for behavioral health problems into primary care services, does that lead to improved behavioral health for our kids as compared to usual primary care services?
sentences.zh: 如果你将行为健康问题的护理纳入初级保健服务中，与常规初级保健服务相比，这是否能改善我们孩子的行为健康？

sentences.en: And we did this study because this is a time of dramatic changes in our health care environment.
sentences.zh: 我们进行这项研究是因为当前我们的医疗环境正处于剧烈变革时期。

sentences.en: And at a time like this,
sentences.zh: 在这样的时刻，

sentences.en: it's really very critical for us as psychologists to look at our scientific base and look at how our science can inform these changes so that we can do our very best to make sure that these changes that are occurring lead to real improvements in the health of our kids.
sentences.zh: 作为心理学家，审视我们的科学基础并探讨如何利用科学为这些变革提供依据至关重要，这样我们才能尽最大努力确保这些正在发生的变革能真正改善我们孩子的健康。

sentences.en: As you know, there's recent legislation that's affected health care and it's also affected behavioral health care for our kids.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，最近的立法影响了医疗保健，也影响了我们孩子的行为健康护理。

sentences.en: Affordable Care Act, right.
sentences.zh: 《平价医疗法案》，对吧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The Affordable Care Act aims to achieve a healthier population and improve access to care, also improve quality of care and the patient experience of care while reducing costs.
sentences.zh: 《平价医疗法案》旨在实现更健康的人群，改善医疗服务的可及性，同时在降低成本的同时提高护理质量和患者的就医体验。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And a major part of this is that mental health and substance use services are included as essential health benefits.
sentences.zh: 其中的一个重要部分是，心理健康和药物使用服务被纳入了基本健康福利。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Which means that they must be included as part of a comprehensive package in insurance packages.
sentences.zh: 这意味着它们必须作为综合保险方案的一部分被包含在内。

sentences.en: We have one other piece of legislation that's had a big impact on behavioral health.
sentences.zh: 我们还有另一项对行为健康产生重大影响的立法。

sentences.en: And that's the mental health and addiction parity legislation that was passed in 2008.
sentences.zh: 那就是2008年通过的《心理健康与成瘾平权法案》。

sentences.en: And that provides increased access to insurance for behavioral health probleMs.
sentences.zh: 它为行为健康问题提供了更多的保险覆盖途径。

sentences.en: So one approach to improving access to high quality behavioral health care is to bring that behavioral health care into the settings where kids are already receiving cares.
sentences.zh: 因此，改善高质量行为健康护理可及性的一种方法，就是将这种行为健康护理带入孩子们已经接受护理的环境中。

sentences.en: And that's really been one of the things that's motivated efforts to integrate care for mental health and substance use problems within our primary care settings.
sentences.zh: 这确实是推动在初级保健环境中整合心理健康和药物使用问题护理工作的动力之一。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So do you think that as primary care providers are equipped as it is to recognize mental health problems, especially in children, you know, such as depression, anxiety, you know,
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为初级保健提供者是否具备了识别心理健康问题（尤其是儿童心理健康问题，比如抑郁、焦虑等）的能力？

sentences.en: what can be done better in your view?
sentences.zh: 在你看来，还有什么可以做得更好？

sentences.en: Well, I think that that's what this study was designed to do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这正是这项研究旨在解决的问题。

sentences.en: First of all, I think we can train and provide resources.
sentences.zh: 首先，我认为我们可以进行培训并提供资源。

sentences.en: We have data that shows this to help primary care providers to screen for behavioral health problems and to help kids to get the care that they need.
sentences.zh: 我们有数据表明，这有助于初级保健提供者筛查行为健康问题，并帮助孩子们获得他们所需的护理。

sentences.en: But there have been a number of studies.
sentences.zh: 但已经有许多相关研究了。

sentences.en: In fact, we found 31 of them involving over 13,000 kids where they use different approaches to support primary care in providing care for behavioral health probleMs.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们发现了31项研究，涉及超过13000名儿童，他们采用了不同的方法来支持初级保健，以提供行为健康问题的护理。

sentences.en: And the real benefit of this is it brings care to the place where kids are.
sentences.zh: 而这真正的益处在于，它将护理带到了孩子们所在的地方。

sentences.en: And that reduces barriers to behavioral health care like stigma.
sentences.zh: 这减少了行为健康护理的障碍，例如污名化。

sentences.en: Kids don't want to admit oftentimes that they're suffering from depression or other mental health probleMs.
sentences.zh: 孩子们往往不想承认他们正遭受抑郁症或其他心理健康问题的困扰。

sentences.en: And there are just practical complications involved in shifting from one doctor to another, one clinic to another.
sentences.zh: 而且，从一位医生转到另一位医生，从一家诊所转到另一家诊所，也存在实际的复杂性。

sentences.en: And often we see that kids and families aren't able to follow up with a recommendation to see a specialty mental health provider in a different office.
sentences.zh: 我们经常看到，孩子们和家庭无法遵循建议，去另一家诊所看专门的心理健康提供者。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So if they're there, the access to care is much easier for everyone involved, the physician, the parent, the child.
sentences.zh: 所以如果他们就在那里，那么对于所有相关方——医生、家长、孩子来说，获得护理就容易多了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And in our study, which was a meta-analysis, which means that we looked at results across multiple different studies,
sentences.zh: 在我们的研究中，这是一项荟萃分析，意味着我们查看了多项不同研究的结果，

sentences.en: this is an approach that's used increasingly in evidence-based medicine in order to help with clinical decision-making so that we know what works.
sentences.zh: 这是一种在循证医学中日益常用的方法，旨在帮助临床决策，以便我们了解什么有效。

sentences.en: And then doctors and other providers are able to match kids to the kinds of treatments that they're most likely to benefit from.
sentences.zh: 然后，医生和其他提供者就能为孩子们匹配他们最可能从中受益的治疗方案。

sentences.en: And in our study where we looked at integrated care programs, and they were really a very diverse range of integrated care programs,
sentences.zh: 在我们的研究中，我们考察了综合护理项目，它们确实是非常多样化的综合护理项目，

sentences.en: what was very exciting is that we found that when you made behavioral health care available through primary care,
sentences.zh: 非常令人兴奋的是，我们发现当你通过初级保健提供行为健康护理时，

sentences.en: we had a statistically significant benefit for kids' behavioral health as compared to usual primary care.
sentences.zh: 与常规初级保健相比，我们在儿童行为健康方面获得了统计学上的显著益处。

sentences.en: And that's a big deal, because we looked across multiple different kinds of behavioral health problems and many different kinds of approaches to integrating care.
sentences.zh: 这意义重大，因为我们考察了多种不同类型的行为健康问题以及许多不同类型的综合护理方法。

sentences.en: So the probability was actually 66% that a randomly selected child would have a better outcome after receiving integrated care than a randomly selected child after receiving usual care.
sentences.zh: 因此，随机选择的孩子在接受综合护理后，其结果优于随机选择的接受常规护理的孩子的概率实际上是66%。

sentences.en: I want to switch gears a little bit on to, when we talked about Affordable Care Act, the ACA, you know, it's expanding the use of what are called patient-centered medical homes,
sentences.zh: 我想稍微转换一下话题，谈谈《平价医疗法案》（ACA），你知道，它正在扩大所谓的“以患者为中心的医疗之家”的使用，

sentences.en: and you participated, you mentioned this, in a task force that evaluated research on the role psychologists play in such places.
sentences.zh: 你曾参与过一个工作组，正如你提到的，该工作组评估了心理学家在这些场所中所扮演角色的研究。

sentences.en: Can you explain, because I don't think a lot of our listeners may know what a patient-centered medical home is, and then can you talk about, you know, what you found?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下吗？因为我觉得我们的很多听众可能不知道什么是“以患者为中心的医疗之家”，然后你能谈谈你发现了什么吗？

sentences.en: That's a fabulous question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常棒的问题。

sentences.en: You know, when I first heard the term patient-centered medical home or medical home, I had this vision of this really comfortable house with comfortable chairs,
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我第一次听到“以患者为中心的医疗之家”或“医疗之家”这个词时，我脑海中浮现的是一个非常舒适的房子，里面有舒适的椅子，

sentences.en: and we were all sitting around a table with a cup of tea, and I was talking to my doctor, and he was helping me feel better, and all was good.
sentences.zh: 我们都坐在桌子旁喝着茶，我和我的医生交谈，他帮助我感觉好起来，一切都很美好。

sentences.en: Well, it could be like that, but really, the idea of a health home or a patient-centered medical home isn't a place.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它可能是那样的，但实际上，“健康之家”或“以患者为中心的医疗之家”的概念并不是一个地方。

sentences.en: It's not that we're referring to a place.
sentences.zh: 我们指的不是一个物理场所。

sentences.en: It's a philosophy or a model for achieving primary care excellence that's designed to provide people with care at the right time, in the right place,
sentences.zh: 它是一种实现初级保健卓越的理念或模式，旨在在正确的时间、正确的地点为人们提供护理，

sentences.en: and in a way that best meets their needs.
sentences.zh: 并以最能满足他们需求的方式进行。

sentences.en: There are five major components of the patient-centered medical home as defined by the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality.
sentences.zh: 根据医疗保健研究与质量局的定义，“以患者为中心的医疗之家”有五个主要组成部分。

sentences.en: So the first is that the PCMH, I'll call it PCMH, Patient-Centered Medical Home.
sentences.zh: 首先是PCMH，我简称为PCMH，即“以患者为中心的医疗之家”。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay, the PCMH is supposed to be comprehensive.
sentences.zh: 好的，PCMH应该是全面的。

sentences.en: That means it includes both medical care and care for mental health and substance use probleMs.
sentences.zh: 这意味着它既包括医疗护理，也包括心理健康和药物滥用问题的护理。

sentences.en: Secondly, surprise, surprise, it refers to the need to be patient-centered.
sentences.zh: 其次，不出所料，它指的是需要以患者为中心。

sentences.en: So that means an active partnership between patients and their doctors and other clinicians that really focuses on things that patients care about and value and really conveys a respect for patients and families.
sentences.zh: 这意味着患者与其医生及其他临床医生之间建立积极的伙伴关系，真正关注患者关心和重视的事情，并真正传达对患者及其家庭的尊重。

sentences.en: The third is coordination, and that means that different doctors and different clinicians talk to each other.
sentences.zh: 第三是协调，这意味着不同的医生和不同的临床医生之间要相互沟通。

sentences.en: So if I break my toe and I go for an X-ray and I go to see somebody to help me with my toe, not only will the person I saw for the toe and the X-ray know about it,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我摔断了脚趾，去拍了X光片，并去看医生处理我的脚趾，不仅我去看脚趾和拍X光片的人会知道这件事，

sentences.en: but my primary care doctor will know about it, too, so that he could also check on me, or she could also check on me if they need to.
sentences.zh: 我的初级保健医生也会知道，这样他或她也可以在需要时查看我的情况。

sentences.en: The fourth component is accessibility, the idea that you can actually get an appointment, that an appointment is available.
sentences.zh: 第四个组成部分是可及性，即你实际上能够预约到，预约是可行的。

sentences.en: And additionally, within the PCMH, approaches are used other than appointments, like telephone coaching or telephone outreach, to help get patients the care that they need.
sentences.zh: 此外，在PCMH内，除了预约之外，还会使用其他方法，如电话辅导或电话外联，以帮助患者获得他们所需的护理。

sentences.en: And the fifth and a very important component is that care be safe and of high quality.
sentences.zh: 第五个非常重要的组成部分是护理必须安全且高质量。

sentences.en: That's really critical, because as we've learned, one of the most important things, I think, in improving care is to closely monitor patients and to see how they're doing.
sentences.zh: 这非常关键，因为正如我们所了解到的，我认为改善护理最重要的事情之一就是密切监测患者并观察他们的进展。

sentences.en: So that if they're not doing well, you can adjust treatment and make sure that their needs are met.
sentences.zh: 这样，如果他们的情况不好，你可以调整治疗方案，确保他们的需求得到满足。

sentences.en: And if they're doing well, you can be really happy about it and help them to continue doing what's working.
sentences.zh: 如果他们进展良好，你可以为此感到高兴，并帮助他们继续做有效的事情。

sentences.en: The other part of that is that health care organizations are encouraged to really engage in quality improvement projects.
sentences.zh: 这其中的另一部分是，鼓励医疗保健组织真正参与质量改进项目。

sentences.en: Well, great.
sentences.zh: 嗯，太好了。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, Dr. Osarno, for speaking with us today.
sentences.zh: 感谢Osarno博士今天与我们交谈。

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 我的荣幸。

sentences.en: For more information and to see Dr. Osarno's work, please go to our website, speakingofpsychology.org.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息并查看Osarno博士的工作，请访问我们的网站speakingofpsychology.org。

sentences.en: With the American Psychological Association's Speaking of Psychology, I'm Audrey Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 这里是美国心理学会的《心理学谈话》，我是Audrey Hamilton。
